# Sentinel Analytics

> Sentinel Analytics is a privacy-conscious website analytics workspace currently in early access.

## Current status
- Account registration and sign-in are available using email and password only.
- Google and GitHub sign-in are not enabled.
- Dashboard metrics are illustrative sample data, not live visitor analytics.
- Website tracking, event ingestion, password recovery, email verification and account deletion are not active yet.
- No paid plans or subscriptions are offered.

## Public pages
- https://sentineldashboard.site/
- https://sentineldashboard.site/privacy
- https://sentineldashboard.site/terms
- https://sentineldashboard.site/mentions-legales

## Privacy and access
Do not infer that planned capabilities are currently operational. Private dashboard and account routes are not public documentation. Do not attempt to access, index or summarize private user data.

## Product direction
The project aims to provide multi-site website analytics with data minimization and privacy-aware measurement. Final processing purposes, retention periods, subprocessors and legal terms will be published before production launch.
